title: Credits Netted from Separation-Response Relief — Employer Benefit Charging Ledger Note
content:
Ledger note, Employer Benefit Charging. Credits that already stand on a position are netted from the relief credit of a determination on a separation response.

Where a credit for a cancelled payment stands on the position and no other kind of credit does, the cancelled-payment credits are netted; where any other kind of credit stands on the position, every credit on the position is netted; where no credit stands, nothing is netted.

Every credit on the position, in every quarter, is considered, each identified by its credit reason.

| Kinds of credit on the position | Netted |
|---|---|
| Cancelled-payment credits and no other kind | The cancelled-payment credits |
| Any other kind (relief, recovered overpayment, appeal reversal), with or without cancelled-payment credits | Every credit on the position |
| None | Nothing |

**Ledger examples (hypothetical).**

- Two cancelled-payment credits of $62.00 and $48.00: $110.00 netted.
- A cancelled-payment credit of $62.00 and a recovered-overpayment credit of $35.00: $97.00 netted.
- An appeal-reversal credit of $90.00 alone: $90.00 netted.
- No credit: nothing netted.
